subject: ETA harmonization & tranche lock: OEM quotes + cloud backfill options
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Esther Lin <esther.lin@bigcloud.com>, orders@oemvendor.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ETA harmonization & tranche lock: OEM quotes + cloud backfill options

Team,

We need to align on lead times and a pragmatic backfill plan for the Acme AI expansion (DEAL-1974). High level: Acme wants a dedicated capacity tranche to go live in Q3; OEM has provided a quote but the ship window is spread and cloud backfill could cover the gap if we can secure capacity quickly.

Attached: initial-reqs.xlsx (SKU counts + target onramp dates).

Asks/constraints:
- Can OEM confirm guaranteed ship week ranges per SKU and whether we can split shipment into two tranches?
- Cloud partner: what are the realistic lead times for procuring reserved capacity in us-west with a 30–60 day ramp? Any temporary burst/credits to bridge?
- Procurement: what contract terms (PO, net-30 vs net-45) will we need to lock to secure the OEM tranche?

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Vendors to confirm firm ETA windows and any expedite options by EOD Thu (1/14).
2) Redwood to decide whether to take a partial tranche vs cloud bridge by Tue (1/19).
3) Host a 30-min sync Thurs (1/14) to review quote reconciliation and confirm action owners.

Ben/Marissa: I put you on Cc for procurement/ops eyes.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Esther Lin <esther.lin@bigcloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ETA harmonization & tranche lock: OEM quotes + cloud backfill options

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the context. Quick take from Cloud side:

- Reserved capacity in us-west: standard procurement lead time is 4–6 weeks for reserved pools (signed order + payment). We can do a week-0 temporary burst (best-effort) for 2–3 weeks while reserved nodes come up, subject to availability.
- We can offer a one-time bridge credit that offsets first-month usage if Redwood commits to a 12-month reserved agreement. That reduces Redwoods' effective cost while you float the OEM shipment.
- If OEM can split a shipment, we recommend locking the smaller tranche (20–30% of required GPUs) immediately to cover peak launch week.

Attached: cloud-backfill-options.pdf (summary of bridge credit, burst availability windows, and procurement checklist).

We have availability for a sync on Thu 1/14 11:00–11:30 PT. Confirm and we will send calendar invite.

Best,
Esther
Esther Lin
Enterprise Sales, BigCloud (Public Cloud Partner)
From: Samir Patel <orders@oemvendor.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Esther Lin <esther.lin@bigcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ETA harmonization & tranche lock: OEM quotes + cloud backfill options

Hi all — attaching the updated OEM quote and the factory schedule snapshot.

Summary:
- SKU: RTX-A4 / RTX-A40 equivalents, total 320 units.
- Production queue position: #12 (as of 1/15).
- Estimated ship windows: 2027-05-18 to 2027-06-08 for full order; we can split into an initial tranche (80 units) to ship 2027-04-25 to 2027-05-05 if you sign and prepay 25% deposit today.
- Expedited lane: additional 12–14 weeks lead if you need full re-prioritization (cost + subject to existing contracts).

Attachment: OEM_Quote_Q3_v2.pdf (line items, lead time assumptions, deposit terms).

Please note: our timeline assumes no material changes to component supply; if demand spikes across our OEM customers, we will provide 10 days' notice on any ETA shift.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Account Executive — OEM Logistics Inc.
orders@oemvendor.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Esther Lin <esther.lin@bigcloud.com>, Samir Patel <orders@oemvendor.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ETA harmonization & tranche lock: OEM quotes + cloud backfill options

Thanks Samir and Esther — this is helpful. Quick internal read and decision path:

1) We will pursue a split approach: lock an initial tranche of 80 units with OEM to land in late April/early May and leverage BigCloud burst + bridge credit for the first 6 weeks post-launch. That reduces risk for Acme and keeps our latency SLA intact.
2) Procurement asks: can Marissa/Ben confirm what payment terms we can offer to OEM procurement? Samir's 25% deposit to secure the tranche seems reasonable, but we need PO and approvals on contract side by EOD Wed (1/20).
3) Ops: Lauren, please validate whether 80 units plus cloud burst covers the expected peak concurrency in the attached MRP (initial-reqs.xlsx).

Action items:
- Samir: confirm a firm ship-by start date for the 80-unit tranche if deposit is received by 1/20.
- Esther: confirm reserved pool provisioning timeline if we sign 12-month reserved and whether the bridge credit can be reflected on our first invoice.
- Marissa/Ben: procurement to prepare PO and payment path; we will include DocuSign link for the OEM quote.

I attached a short mutual-action-plan.docx to capture these steps — please review and comment inline; I will send a DocuSign for the OEM quote once procurement confirms PO path.

Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <orders@oemvendor.com>, Esther Lin <esther.lin@bigcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ETA harmonization & tranche lock: OEM quotes + cloud backfill options

All — procurement update and decision.

We will proceed with the tranche lock. PO has been created and the legal/finance approval path is green — estimated PO issuance 1/24 (net-30 standard; we will request 45 days only if OEM requires). Attached are the internal PO stub references in our finance system.

Samir: please confirm the invoice address and final deposit amount to enable payment initiation. If you confirm the 80-unit ship-start week of 2027-04-25 by COB Monday (1/25), we will route the 25% deposit immediately after PO issuance and sign the DocuSign.

Esther: once PO is issued we will need a one-page statement from BigCloud outlining the bridge credit terms (amount, applicable invoices, and timing) so Finance can reconcile.

Thanks everyone — Karthik, I'll follow up on the DocuSign link when the PO is live.

-Ben

--
Ben Carter
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
